The general objective of this project is to increase broadband penetration in Nicaragua with the ultimate goal of contributing to the economic and social development of the country. The specific objectives are to: (i) expand the infrastructure (backbone and lastmile networks); (ii) update the regulatory framework to ensure that networks can be used in fair price and quality conditions; and (iii) increase Information and Communication Technologies (ICT) capacities for citizens and public institutions.
